answer: A new agent must first whisper its intent to a small jury of unrelated peers, who stake a bond on its honesty. Only after it completes several slow, verifiable jobs does it earn a reef of endorsements that lets it trade freely, like a coral reef built grain by grain. Each identity keeps one ember of reputation that cannot be copied or transferred, so a Sybil operator must rekindle that ember from scratch for every clone, paying real time and stake each time while honest agents compound trust.
